review_candidates.description: Get to Know Us Horizon3 is a fast-growing, cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results. This is a role for a seasoned leader who wants to build, shape, and grow. The team may expand over time, but the role is already broader than team size. It is about leading the segment in-region, building a strategy for the segment in the market, working across functions, growing through partners, and helping shape how Commercial scales across EMEA. You will own the Commercial segment in your region. You will be responsible for how the market develops, how the team performs, how partners work with us, and how we scale the business in a way that fits the reality of the region. How we work Our team is based in the Amsterdam hub, where people come together, collaborate, learn from each other, and build community around the motion. At the same time, we work for and in our local markets, so extensive travel across the region is part of the role. This leader needs to be visible in the market, work closely with partners and customers, represent the business through customer engagement, partner activity, executive meetings, and regional events, and help lead the development of the markets together with Enterprise sellers and Partner Managers. Own the full Commercial motion in your region across partners, distributors, enablement, deal strategy, and market execution. Shape regional strategy and turn it into clear market plans, investment choices, and growth actions. Drive growth across priority markets by aligning partner activity, local market plans, and cross-functional execution. Help define how the region should scale over time, including hiring, market expansion, and where to place additional investment as the business grows. Build strong relationships with senior leaders across partner organisations, the distributor, the channel team, and the MSSP team in each territory, and shape business plans with partners. Build a repeatable motion that helps partners, distributors, and the wider team create market reach, demand, and Commercial momentum. Partner closely with Partner Marketing, Field Marketing, Sales Engineers, Engineering, Product, Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Channel, and distribution to help the region execute well. Own team productivity and enablement, including fast ramp, readiness, ongoing development, and helping people become successful as quickly as possible. Act as a trusted advisor to sales leadership by bringing clear market insight, practical recommendations, and feedback from the field. Travel extensively across the region to build presence in the markets, strengthen local relationships, and support execution where it matters most. What success looks like Success in this role is about creating real impact in the region and helping Commercial grow in a way that is visible in the market, well supported by partners, and built to scale across EMEA. You Will Be Successful If You Expand our reach and presence across the region through partners, distributors, MSSPs, and the wider ecosystem. Help create new logo momentum and meaningful market impact across the Commercial segment. Build markets that are well connected, well supported, and set up to grow over time. Bring clarity to where we invest, which markets we prioritise, and how we help the region scale well. Help the team ramp quickly, become productive, and continue to grow in-role. Bring useful market insight back into the business so strategy, enablement, and investment decisions stay close to what is happening in the field. What we are looking for We are looking for an experienced leader who has done this before: someone who knows how to build a region, build markets, and drive growth in a fast-paced organisation. You should be comfortable operating across markets with different levels of maturity, working cross-functionally, and creating structure in a fast-scaling environment. Experience working in hypergrowth is strongly preferred. We Are Looking For Someone Who Brings Strong leadership values, good judgement, and the presence to lead with credibility across a diverse set of markets and stakeholders. An established network across partners, distributors, and the regional ecosystem. The ability to create clarity, trust, and accountability, and help strong people perform at a high level without over-controlling how the work gets done. A leadership style that stays close to the market, coaches with intent, makes deliberate choices, and works well across boundaries. Native German speaker with excellent English Why this role matters This is a chance to shape how Commercial grows across EMEA. You will help build markets, grow people, work closely with partners, and influence how the business scales in-region. If you want a role that combines regional leadership, market building, team growth, and real influence on how Commercial develops across EMEA, this is that role. Perks of Horizon3 Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive. Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities. Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking. Hybrid Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Amsterdam office, where some roles require regular in-office presence. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless. As a technology expert, you will work closely with customers, contribute to the definition of the technical architecture, and help define and maintain the end-to-end technical infrastructure required for IT solutions. You will also be responsible for understanding and implementing business rules and requirements related to customer systems and applications within recurrent business. What you will do Support the implementation, administration, and operation of applications and systems in test environments. Contribute to the definition and implementation of technical architecture and infrastructure for IT solutions. Support application deployment and system/application management activities. Monitor systems and services proactively, identify potential issues, and support troubleshooting and root cause analysis. Automate recurring operational tasks using scripting and automation tools. Support containerized environments and related deployment processes. Work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to understand technical and business requirements. Proactively develop procedures and improvements to prevent outages and reduce their severity. Create and maintain clear, comprehensive technical documentation. Continuously develop technical knowledge and stay up to date with relevant technologies and practices. You will bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. Maximum 2 years of prior experience in application and/or system management. Strong Linux command-line knowledge. Basic knowledge of Python and Bash scripting for automating daily operational tasks. Operational understanding of proactive system and service monitoring frameworks and tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Nagios. Solid understanding of SDLC processes and testing frameworks.
